name: supermarket-system
description: Modern 3D Supermarket POS + Back Office Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,POS,BACKOFFICE" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:pos" "npm run dev:backoffice"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd Backend && npm install && cd ../POS && npm install && cd ../BackOffice && npm install
scripts.build: cd Backend && npm run build && cd ../POS && npm run build && cd ../BackOffice && npm run build
